in_sanskrit.name: Shilabha
in_sanskrit.meaning: That which is made of rock or stone
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Silambu in Sanskrit can be derived from the word 'Shilabha', which means 'that which is made of rock or stone'. This meaning is quite different from the Tamil meaning, but it's an interesting etymology to explore.

in_hindi.name: Shilam
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Silambu in Hindi can be derived from the word 'Shilam', which means 'rock or stone'. This meaning is also related to the Tamil meaning, as bamboo can be considered a type of hard, fibrous material similar to rock or stone.

in_tamil.name: Silambu
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Silambu in Tamil means 'bamboo' or 'stick'. This name might have originated from the use of bamboo sticks in various rituals and ceremonies in Indian culture.

in_telugu.name: Silabu
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Silambu in Telugu can be derived from the word 'Silabu', which means 'rock' or 'stone'. This meaning is related to the Sanskrit and Hindi meanings, as bamboo can be considered a hard, fibrous material similar to rock or stone.

in_marathi.name: Silambu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Silambu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Silambu means a garland made up of jasmine flowers, beads or rice. It also refers to anything that is round or circular in shape. In Hindu mythology, Lord Murugan is often depicted wearing a silambu around his waist.
